meanings.usage: 指故意制造的欺骗他人取乐的虚假事件
常用来描述靠气体压力工作的工具或设备
指用于钻孔的工具，pneumatic drill即风钻、气动钻机
指故意误导他人的行为或手段
常用搭配indulge in sth，表示放任自己做某事
指受到伤害、欺骗或不利影响的人
常用搭配be grateful to sb for sth，表示因某事感谢某人
用于描述在事件发生前给出的信息、通知等
指带有拱形顶的通道或入口
常用搭配threaten to do sth，表示扬言要做某事
常用搭配remonstrate with sb，表示向某人提出异议或规劝
用来描述动作或情绪的强烈程度
用于描述带有讽刺意味的说话或行为方式
表示正式允许某人做某事，常用被动语态permission was granted
表示和某人一起去某处，常用搭配accompany sb to sp

phrases.usage: 表示专门从事、专攻某一领域或活动

examples.en: The company specializes in organic skincare products.
examples.zh: 这家公司专门生产有机护肤产品。

phrases.usage: 表示装扮成、打扮成特定的样子

examples.en: The little girl dressed up as a princess for the Halloween party.
examples.zh: 小女孩在万圣节派对上装扮成了公主。

examples.en: It took the firefighters three hours to put out the forest fire.
examples.zh: 消防员花了三个小时才扑灭这场森林火灾。

phrases.usage: 表示认真对待某人、把某人的话当回事

examples.en: Don't take him seriously - he's always making silly jokes.
examples.zh: 别把他的话当真，他总爱开无聊的玩笑。

phrases.usage: 表示开某人的玩笑、捉弄某人

examples.en: The boys love to play jokes on their classmates on April Fool's Day.
examples.zh: 男孩子们喜欢在愚人节那天捉弄同学。

examples.en: The police were on the scene within five minutes of receiving the emergency call.
examples.zh: 警察接到紧急电话后五分钟内就赶到了现场。

phrases.usage: 表示靠武力、用强制手段

examples.en: The security guards had to remove the troublemaker by force.
examples.zh: 保安不得不强行把闹事者带走。

examples.en: He lost his temper when he found his laptop had been damaged.
examples.zh: 当他发现自己的笔记本电脑被弄坏时，他发了脾气。

examples.en: The suspect was under arrest for stealing cars.
examples.zh: 这名嫌疑人因盗窃车辆被逮捕。

examples.en: I need to make a telephone call to my parents to tell them I'll be home late.
examples.zh: 我得给我父母打个电话，告诉他们我会晚点儿回家。

grammar.title: only引导的部分倒装句
grammar.structure: Only + 状语/状语从句 + 助动词/情态动词/be动词 + 主语 + 谓语剩余部分
grammar.definition: 当"only+状语（从句）"位于句首时，句子需要使用部分倒装结构，即将助动词、情态动词或be动词提到主语之前，强调该状语的条件性 用于强调只有在某个条件下才会发生某事，突出条件的重要性

examples.en: Only when he saw that the man was actually telephoning the police did he realize that they had all been the victims of a hoax.
examples.zh: 当他看到那个人真的在给警察打电话时，他才意识到他们所有人都成了一场恶作剧的受害者。

examples.en: Only by practicing every day can you improve your spoken English quickly.
examples.zh: 只有每天练习，你才能快速提高英语口语。

patterns.pattern: It has never been explained why...

original.en: It has never been explained why university students seem to enjoy practical jokes more than anyone else.
original.zh: 为什么大学生似乎比其他人更喜欢搞恶作剧，这一点一直没有得到解释。

imitations.en: It has never been explained why this ancient custom disappeared suddenly hundreds of years ago.
imitations.zh: 为什么这个古老的习俗在几百年前突然消失，一直没有得到解释。

imitations.en: It has never been explained why he quit his well-paid job without telling anyone.
imitations.zh: 为什么他没告诉任何人就辞掉了高薪工作，这一点没人说得清。

patterns.pattern: As soon as sb had done sth, sb did sth else

original.en: As soon as he had hung up, he went over to the workmen and told them that if a policeman ordered them to go away, they were not to take him seriously.
original.zh: 他一挂电话，就走到工人那里，告诉他们如果有警察命令他们离开，不要把他当回事。

imitations.en: As soon as she had finished her homework, she went to the park to walk her dog.
imitations.zh: 她一做完作业，就去公园遛狗了。

imitations.en: As soon as the guests had left, he started to clean up the messy living room.
imitations.zh: 客人一走，他就开始打扫乱糟糟的客厅。

original.en: At this, the police pointed out ironically that this would hardly be necessary as the men were already under arrest.
original.zh: 听到这话，警察讽刺地指出，这几乎没有必要，因为这两个人已经被逮捕了。

imitations.en: At this, the little girl burst into tears and ran to her mother.
imitations.zh: 听到这话，小女孩突然哭了起来，跑向她的妈妈。

imitations.en: At this, the manager smiled and nodded to show his agreement with the proposal.
imitations.zh: 听到这里，经理笑了笑，点头表示他同意这个提议。

lines.en: It has never been explained why university students seem to enjoy practical jokes more than else.
lines.zh: 谁也弄不清为什么大学生好像比任何人都更喜欢恶作剧。

lines.en: Students specialize in a particular type of practical joke: the hoax Inviting the fire brigade to put out a nonexistent fire is a crude form of deception which no self-respecting student would ever indulge in.
lines.zh: 大学生擅长一种特殊的恶作剧——戏弄人。

lines.en: Students often create amusing situations which are funny to everyone except the victims.
lines.zh: 请消防队来扑灭一场根本没有的大火是一种低级骗局，有自尊心的大学生决不会去做。

lines.en: When a student recently saw two workmen using a pneumatic drill outside his university, he immediately telephoned the police and informed them that two students dressed up as workmen were tearing up the road with a pneumatic drill.
lines.zh: 大学生们常常做的是制造一种可笑的局面，使大家笑上一场，当然受害者是笑不出来的。

lines.en: As soon as he had hung up, he went over to the workmen and told them that if a policeman ordered them to go away, they were not take him seriously.
lines.zh: 最近有个学生看见两个工人在学校门外用风钻干活，马上打电话报告警察，说有两个学生装扮成工人，正在用风钻破坏路面。

lines.en: He added that a student had dressed up as a policeman and was playing all sorts of silly jokes on people.
lines.zh: 挂上电话后，他又马上来到工人那儿，告诉他们若有个警察来让他们走开，不要把他当回事，还对工人说，有个学生常装扮成警察无聊地同别人开玩笑。

lines.en: Both the police and the workmen were grateful to the student for this piece of advance information.
lines.zh: 警察与工人都对那个学生事先通报情况表示感谢。

lines.en: The student did in an archway nearby where he could watch and hear everything that went on. Sure enough, a policeman arrived on the scene and politely asked the workmen to go away.
lines.zh: 那个学生躲在附近一拱形的门廊里，在那儿可以看见、听到现场发生的一切。

lines.en: When he received a very rude reply from one of the workmen. He threatened to remove them by force.
lines.zh: 果然，警察来了，不礼貌地请工人离开此地；但其中一个工人粗鲁地回了几句。

lines.en: The workmen told him to do as he pleased and the policeman telephoned for help.
lines.zh: 于是警察威胁要强行使他们离开。

lines.en: Shortly afterwards, four more policemen arrived and remonstrated with the workmen.
As the men refused to stop working, the police attempted to seize the pneumatic drill.
The workmen struggled fiercely and one of them lost his temper.
lines.zh: 一会儿工夫，又来了4个警察，规劝工人离开。

lines.en: He threatened to call the police.
lines.zh: 由于工人拒绝停下手中的活，警察想夺风钻。

lines.en: At this, the police pointed out ironically that this would hardly be necessary as the men were already under arrest.
lines.zh: 两个工人奋力抗争，其中一个发了火，威胁说要去叫警察。

lines.en: Pretending to speak seriously, one of the workmen asked if he might make a telephone call before being taken to the station.
lines.zh: 警察听后讥讽地说，这大可不必，因为他俩已被逮捕了。

lines.en: Permission was granted and a policeman accompanied him to a pay phone.
lines.zh: 其中一个工人装模作样地问道，在被带往警察局之前，是否可以打一个电话。

lines.en: Only when he saw that the man was actually telephoning the police did he realize that they had all been the victims of a hoax.
lines.zh: 警察同意了，陪他来到一个投币地电话前，当他看到那个工人真的是给警察挂电话，才恍然大悟，原来他们都成一场骗局的受害者。

questions.q: How did the policeman discover that the whole thing was a joke?
questions.zh: 警察是怎么发现整件事其实是个玩笑的？
questions.a: Only when he accompanied one of the 'workmen' to a pay phone and saw that the man was actually telephoning the police did he realize that they had all been the victims of a hoax.
questions.aZh: 直到他陪其中一个'工人'来到投币电话旁，看到那人真的是在给警察打电话，他才恍然大悟：他们全都成了一场骗局的受害者。
questions.hint: 见课文最后一句（Only when he saw that the man was actually telephoning the police...）。

questions.q: Why did the student telephone the police?
questions.zh: 那个学生为什么给警察打电话？
questions.a: He informed them that two students dressed up as workmen were tearing up the road with a pneumatic drill.
questions.aZh: 他报告说有两个学生装扮成工人，正用风钻破坏路面。
questions.hint: 见第4句（When a student recently saw two workmen using a pneumatic drill...）。

questions.q: What did the student tell the real workmen after he had hung up?
questions.zh: 挂断电话后，那个学生对真正的工人说了什么？
questions.a: He told them that if a policeman ordered them to go away, they should not take him seriously, and added that a student had dressed up as a policeman and was playing all sorts of silly jokes on people.
questions.aZh: 他告诉他们，若有个警察让他们走开，别把那人当回事；还说有个学生常装扮成警察，无聊地同人开玩笑。
questions.hint: 见第5、6句（As soon as he had hung up... / He added that...）。

questions.q: How did the workmen react when the police tried to remove them?
questions.zh: 当警察想赶走工人时，工人是如何反应的？
questions.a: They refused to stop working, so the police tried to seize the pneumatic drill; the workmen struggled fiercely, one of them lost his temper and threatened to call the police.
questions.aZh: 他们拒绝停工，警察便想夺走风钻；两个工人奋力抗争，其中一个发了火，威胁要去叫警察。
questions.hint: 见第11至13句（As the men refused to stop working...）。

questions.q: Why is this hoax so effective, and who ends up being the 'victims'?
questions.zh: 这场恶作剧为什么如此奏效？最终谁成了'受害者'？
questions.a: It works by setting the police against the workmen so that everyone except the student is fooled; in the end both the police and the workmen are the victims of the hoax, and the truth comes out only when the workman really telephones the police.
questions.aZh: 它让警察与工人彼此对立，除那个学生外所有人都上了当；最后警察和工人都成了一场骗局的受害者，直到工人真的打电话报警，真相才水落石出。
questions.hint: 结合开头'funny to everyone except the victims'与结尾'victims of a hoax'作答。

translation:
谁也弄不清为什么大学生好像比任何人都更喜欢恶作剧。
大学生擅长一种特殊的恶作剧——戏弄人。
请消防队来扑灭一场根本没有的大火是一种低级骗局，有自尊心的大学生决不会去做。
大学生们常常做的是制造一种可笑的局面，使大家笑上一场，当然受害者是笑不出来的。
最近有个学生看见两个工人在学校门外用风钻干活，马上打电话报告警察，说有两个学生装扮成工人，正在用风钻破坏路面。
挂上电话后，他又马上来到工人那儿，告诉他们若有个警察来让他们走开，不要把他当回事，还对工人说，有个学生常装扮成警察无聊地同别人开玩笑。
警察与工人都对那个学生事先通报情况表示感谢。
那个学生躲在附近一拱形的门廊里，在那儿可以看见、听到现场发生的一切。
果然，警察来了，不礼貌地请工人离开此地；但其中一个工人粗鲁地回了几句。
于是警察威胁要强行使他们离开。
工人说，悉听尊便。
警察去打电话叫人。
一会儿工夫，又来了4个警察，规劝工人离开。
由于工人拒绝停下手中的活，警察想夺风钻。
两个工人奋力抗争，其中一个发了火，威胁说要去叫警察。
警察听后讥讽地说，这大可不必，因为他俩已被逮捕了。
其中一个工人装模作样地问道，在被带往警察局之前，是否可以打一个电话。
警察同意了，陪他来到一个投币地电话前，当他看到那个工人真的是给警察挂电话，才恍然大悟，原来他们都成一场骗局的受害者。
title: Who's Who
subtitle: 名人录

lead.question: 那个学生用一通电话，怎样让警察和真正的工人都成了恶作剧的受害者？
lead.warmup: 先想一想：你听过或经历过的恶作剧（practical joke）里，哪一次最'高明'？恶作剧的妙处，常在于被耍的人最后才知道真相。本文中，一名大学生只用两通电话，就让警察和真正的工人都上了当。阅读时请留意三点：作者为何说这类玩笑'除了受害者，人人都觉得好笑'；学生分别对警察和工人说了什么；警察又是在哪一刻才明白这整件事是一场骗局。
goals: 掌握本篇恶作剧叙事的关键词汇：hoax, deception, victim, indulge in, dress up, tear up 等。
理解并运用被动语态：It has never been explained... / Permission was granted.
学会用定语从句及 only when、as soon as 等结构串连叙事。
能复述这则'整人不成反被整'的连锁骗局，体会其中的幽默与讽刺。
lead.summary: 课文讲的是大学生最爱的恶作剧——'戏弄人'。请消防队扑灭一场根本不存在的大火，只是低级的骗人把戏；真正的行家会设下让人真假难辨的圈套。一名学生谎报有两个'装扮成工人的人在破坏路面'，又提醒两位真正的工人别理会前来驱赶他们的警察。结果警察和工人都成了这场恶作剧的受害者，直到工人真的打电话报警，大家才恍然大悟。
lead.tips: 易错点：dress up as sb 表示'装扮成某人'，as 后接身份或职业，不能用 like；而 be dressed in 后接的是衣服（如 in a tight black dress）。此外 take sb seriously（认真对待某人）不能写成 take sb serious。

exercises.q: 汉译英：谁也弄不清为什么大学生好像比任何人都更喜欢恶作剧。
exercises.a: It has never been explained why university students seem to enjoy practical jokes more than anyone else.
exercises.note: it 作形式主语 + 现在完成时被动

exercises.q: 改为被动语态：The police had already arrested the two men. →
exercises.a: The two men had already been arrested (by the police).
exercises.note: 过去完成时被动：had been + 过去分词

exercises.q: 用短语动词填空：The student ______ ______ as a policeman and played all sorts of silly jokes on people.（他装扮成一个警察）
exercises.note: dress up as 装扮成某身份

exercises.q: 改错：Both the police and the workmen was grateful to the student for this piece of advance information.
exercises.a: was → were（both...and... 连接的并列主语，谓语用复数）
exercises.note: both A and B 谓语用复数

exercises.q: 汉译英：请消防队来扑灭一场根本没有的大火是一种低级骗局。
exercises.a: Inviting the fire brigade to put out a nonexistent fire is a crude form of deception.
exercises.note: 动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数

exercises.q: 用定语从句合并：Students often create amusing situations. They are funny to everyone except the victims.
exercises.a: Students often create amusing situations which are funny to everyone except the victims.
exercises.note: which 引导定语从句，指代 situations

exercises.q: 用所给动词的适当形式填空（间接引语）：He told the workmen that if a policeman ______ (order) them to go away, they ______ (not take) him seriously.
exercises.note: 祈使句变间接引语用 be to 结构

quiz.q: '若有个警察让你们走开，别把他当回事。'其中'别把他当回事'的英文是？
quiz.note: take sb seriously 为固定搭配

quiz.q: 下面哪一句正确表达'谁也弄不清为什么……'？
options: It has never been explained why...
quiz.note: it 形式主语 + 现在完成时被动

quiz.q: 'put out a nonexistent fire' 中 put out 的意思是？
文中 'hoax' 与下列哪个意思最接近？
quiz.note: hoax 意为恶作剧、戏弄、骗局

quiz.q: Students often create amusing situations ______ are funny to everyone except the victims. 空白处应填？
quiz.note: 先行词为物，从句缺主语，用 which

quiz.q: 文末 'the men were already under arrest' 意思是？
options: they had been caught by the police
